title: Grammar v0 Feature Checklist and EBNF Generator
description: Configure boolean feature flags in FEATURES and generate the corresponding EBNF statement rules, expression precedence ladder, and primary forms.

steps.description: Define the FEATURES dictionary with the eight required core flags, optional language features (such as functions, return, and lists), and the custom niche_feature metadata.
In emit_grammar(f), assemble the statement alternatives and statement production rules based on which flags in f are True.

steps.question: Which EBNF productions are added to the output when f['functions'] is True?
steps.answer: It adds '| fun_decl' to statement (line 46), the fun_decl and params rules (lines 63-64), and the function-call form IDENT '(' ( expr ( ',' expr )* )? ')' to primary (line 96).

steps.description: Append the expression precedence ladder from or_expr down to unary and join the enabled primary forms into the primary production.
Call emit_grammar(FEATURES), print the EBNF skeleton, and summarize which core and optional features are enabled or disabled.
Watch emit_grammar append '| fun_decl' to the statement rule when f['functions'] is True.
